# Measure the Pixels

Jeff shares Seestar S50 astrophotography, measured image processing, and the development of NOVA on the Measure the Pixels site and channel.

This experimental index lists selected public pages.

- [Home](https://measurethepixels.com/): Jeff's Seestar S50 astrophotography and NOVA project.
- [About NOVA](https://measurethepixels.com/about.html): Measured processing and the system's limits.
- [Handbook](https://measurethepixels.com/handbook/): Authored processing methods and evidence.
- [Gallery](https://measurethepixels.com/gallery.html): Finished images and recorded assessments.
- [Build log](https://measurethepixels.com/changelog.html): Experiments and processing changes.
